format: Perfect Order (POR): cards not already in the pool. H and later = Standard; G = Expanded.

attacks.name: Gooey Thread
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Poison Ring
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned, and it can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Send Flowers
attacks.text: Find an Energy card in your deck and attach it to 1 of your Benched Grass Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Hide
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, prevent all damage and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Grand Wing
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may have your opponent shuffle their hand and put it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards there, they draw 4 cards.

attacks.name: Blow Through
attacks.text: Does 60 more damage if a Stadium is in play.

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Find a Pokémon in your deck, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Feather Shot
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

abilities.name: Sniper's Eye
abilities.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 cards in their hand, ignore all Colorless Energy in the costs of this Pokémon's attacks.

attacks.name: Crushing Arrow
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sky Hunt
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. On heads, discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Find up to 2 cards in your deck and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Dire Nails
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Burned and Poisoned. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

abilities.name: Shell Spikes
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon (even if it's Knocked Out), discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Heat Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, does 80 more damage.

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As many times as you like during your turn, you may move a Water Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jetting Blow
attacks.text: Also does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

attacks.name: Nebula Beam
attacks.text: Weakness, Resistance and effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon don't change this attack's damage.

attacks.name: Hydro Turn
attacks.text: Does 30 damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Asleep.

abilities.name: Tundra Wall
abilities.text: Your Pokémon with any Water Energy attached take 50 less damage from attacks by your opponent's Pokémon (after Weakness and Resistance). Multiple copies of this Ability don't add up.

attacks.name: Freezing Chill
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Powerful Steam
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. Does 90 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Double Scratch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Does 10 damage for each heads.

abilities.name: Fighting Roar
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this Pokémon can evolve on your first turn or on the turn you played it.

attacks.name: Incessant Onslaught
attacks.text: Does 70 damage for each Prize card you have taken.

attacks.name: Strong Volt
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tail Generator
attacks.text: Attach Basic Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile to your Lightning Pokémon however you like, up to the amount of Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Follow Me
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon into the Active Spot.

attacks.name: Double Eater
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Energy cards from your hand. Does 60 damage for each card discarded this way.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Confused.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Scent Collection
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may find up to 2 Basic Psychic Energy cards in your deck, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Obliterating Nose
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. On tails, the attack doesn't happen.

attacks.name: Twister Spewing
attacks.text: If you played Tarragon from your hand this turn, discard the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: Resistance doesn't apply to this attack's damage.

attacks.name: Screw Knuckle
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

attacks.name: Vengeful Kick
attacks.text: Does 60 more damage if any of your Benched Pokémon have damage counters on them.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

abilities.name: Infinite Shadow
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack of your opponent's Pokémon, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile. (Discard its attached cards.)

attacks.name: Mind Jack
attacks.text: Does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Soul Destroyer
attacks.text: Knock Out each of your opponent's Pokémon that has 50 HP or less left.

attacks.name: Dark Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Dark Strike during your next turn.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Rising Blade
attacks.text: Does 80 more damage if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex.

attacks.name: Metal Slash
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Memory Lock
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use it during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Scrape Off
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard every Pokémon Tool from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Retaliatory Incisors
attacks.text: Does 40 damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Rattata.

attacks.name: Gormandizer
attacks.text: Flip coins until you get tails. Find up to that many Basic Energy cards in your deck and attach them to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Collapse
attacks.text: This Pokémon becomes Asleep.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Also does 30 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon).

attacks.name: Chirp
attacks.text: Find up to 2 Pokémon with Fighting Resistance in your deck, show them to your opponent and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Hand Trim
attacks.text: Discard random cards from your opponent's hand until they have 5 cards in their hand.

cards.name: Antique Jaw Fossil

abilities.name: Intimidating Jaw
abilities.text: While this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 30 less damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

cards.text: Play this card as a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. It can't be affected by Special Conditions and can't retreat. You can discard it from play at any time during your turn. Ability Intimidating Jaw: while it is in the Active Spot, attacks used by your opponent's Active Pokémon do 30 less damage (before Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Antique Sail Fossil

abilities.name: Protective Sail
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of Supporter cards your opponent plays from their hand done to this Pokémon.

cards.text: Play this card as a 60-HP Basic Colorless Pokémon. It can't be affected by Special Conditions and can't retreat. You can discard it from play at any time during your turn. Ability Protective Sail: prevent all effects of your opponent's Supporter cards done to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Core Memory

attacks.name: Geobuster
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.text: The Mega Zygarde ex this card is attached to can use the attack on this card (it still needs the Energy).

cards.name: Energy Search
cards.text: Find a Basic Energy card in your deck, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Energy Swatter
cards.text: Your opponent shows you their hand. Put an Energy card from it on the bottom of their deck.

cards.name: Hole-Digging Shovel
cards.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Jacinthe
cards.text: Heal 150 damage from 1 of your Psychic Pokémon.

cards.name: Lumiose Galette
cards.text: Heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon and remove a Special Condition from it.

cards.name: Naveen
cards.text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand, then draw until you have 5 cards in your hand. (You can't play this card if it wouldn't let you draw.)

cards.name: Poké Ball
cards.text: Flip a coin. On heads, find a Pokémon in your deck, show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Potion
cards.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Tarragon
cards.text: Put up to 4 Fighting Pokémon and Basic Fighting Energy cards, in any combination, from your discard pile into your hand.
